documents.title: Cynbit Technologies – Company overview
documents.text: Cynbit Technologies is a software and AI automation company based in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Public website describes autonomous AI agents, custom software development, scalable business platforms, custom IT infrastructure, proprietary SaaS products, AI-first thinking, end-to-end development, cloud infrastructure and digital marketing. The company also describes a social impact partnership with Manav Seva Trust for computer and IT teaching in rural areas and government schools.

documents.title: AI automation and autonomous agents
documents.text: Cynbit describes autonomous AI agents and cognitive automation, smart assistants that manage leads and coordination, LLM automation for manual data entry and document handling, AI voice agents, and integration of AI stacks into existing SaaS platforms.

documents.title: Full-stack and backend software development
documents.text: Cynbit describes scalable web and mobile platforms, full-stack development, secure backend systems, cloud solutions and legacy system modernization. Publicly listed frameworks include React, Next.js, NestJS, FastAPI, Django and Tailwind; languages include TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java and C++.

documents.title: Cloud infrastructure and migration
documents.text: Cynbit describes cloud infrastructure and deployment across AWS and Azure, secure cloud foundations, cloud migration and modernization of monolithic systems into distributed systems. The services page lists cloud and operations technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD.

documents.title: Digital marketing, SEO and CRM automation
documents.text: Cynbit describes performance advertising, technical SEO, CRM automation and funnel optimization. The public service page mentions Google and Meta Ads, technical SEO, automated lead nurturing and conversion-focused landing pages.

documents.title: Cynbit Studio
documents.text: Cynbit Studio is described as an AI-powered career growth and learning platform for students and developers. Public features include placement assessment, adaptive learning paths, AI coding missions, AI code evaluation, AI mentor support, mock interviews, resume tools, job matching analysis, skill tracking and certificates.

documents.title: TenantEase
documents.text: TenantEase is described as a smart property and tenant management platform. Public features include property and unit tracking, tenant profiles, rent and payment tracking, automated reminders, payment history, occupancy and revenue dashboards.

documents.title: Revio
documents.text: Revio is described as an AI reputation and sentiment management platform. Public features include cross-platform review sync, AI-assisted review responses, sentiment intelligence, crisis detection, multi-location management and role-based access for admins, managers and advisors.

documents.title: WizHealth: AI Diagnostic Triage: Enhancing Medical Efficiency.
documents.text: Client/project: WizHealth. Industry: Healthcare. Challenge: Clinicians were overwhelmed with a high volume of symptoms, making it difficult to prioritize urgent cases effectively. Solution: Built an AI model that categorizes symptoms based on severity and urgency, integrating directly with existing patient records. Published outcome: Improved triage efficiency by 25% and reduced turnaround time for urgent patient consultations. Technologies and capabilities: AI / Machine Learning, healthcare workflow, patient records.

documents.title: Pragya Healths: IoT Remote Patient Monitoring for Rural Health.
documents.text: Client/project: Pragya Healths. Industry: Healthcare. Challenge: Chronic patients in remote areas lacked consistent monitoring, leading to avoidable emergency situations. Solution: Developed a mobile app that syncs vitals from wearable devices to a central clinician dashboard with automated alerts. Published outcome: Achieved a 40% reduction in emergency room visits for patients enrolled in the monitoring program. Technologies and capabilities: IoT, mobile app, wearable integration, dashboards, alerts.

Solution: Built a QR-based tracking system that allows customers to scan a meal and see the entire journey from farm to table. Published outcome: Strengthened brand trust and drove a 20% increase in premium subscription orders. Technologies and capabilities: Supply-chain traceability, QR codes, tracking.

documents.text: Client/project: Cloudy Tales. Industry: Software / Collaboration. Solution: Refactored the communication layer using optimized WebSockets and Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs). Published outcome: Delivered a zero-latency collaborative environment supporting 50k+ active writers globally. Technologies and capabilities: WebSockets, CRDTs, real-time collaboration, backend.

documents.title: Urban Wardrobe: AR Virtual Try-On: Redefining the Fashion Experience.
documents.text: Client/project: Urban Wardrobe. Industry: Retail / Fashion. Challenge: High return rates due to sizing and fit issues were eroding profit margins for the online boutique. Solution: Developed a mobile-optimized AR fitting room that utilizes camera data to provide accurate size recommendations and visual overlays. Published outcome: Saw a 22% reduction in return rates and a 15% increase in average order value (AOV). Technologies and capabilities: AR, e-commerce, mobile UX, recommendations.

documents.title: Evento: Scaling Real-time Ticketing for Major Entertainment.
documents.text: Client/project: Evento. Industry: Events / Ticketing. Challenge: Legacy servers frequently crashed during high-demand ticket drops, leading to lost revenue and customer frustration. Published outcome: Successfully managed 100k+ concurrent users with zero downtime during the Summer Beats tour. Technologies and capabilities: AWS Lambda, SQS, serverless, scalability, ticketing.

documents.title: GlobalPay: Revolutionizing cross-border payments for the next billion users.
documents.text: Client/project: GlobalPay. Industry: Fintech. Challenge: Existing systems struggled with high latency and complex regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions. Solution: Built a microservices-based ledger system using Node.js and PostgreSQL, deployed on an auto-scaling Kubernetes cluster with real-time fraud detection. Published outcome: Successfully handled 2.4M+ active daily users with sub-200ms transaction latency and stated compliance across 15 countries. Technologies and capabilities: Fintech, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, fraud detection.

documents.text: Client/project: EliteVogue. Industry: Retail / E-commerce. Challenge: Legacy monolithic commerce platform was too slow for modern mobile users and difficult to scale globally. Solution: Architected a headless commerce solution using Next.js for the frontend and a decoupled GraphQL API for backend services. Published outcome: Reduced load speed to 0.8s on average and saw a 38% increase in conversion rate within the first quarter. Technologies and capabilities: Next.js, GraphQL, headless commerce, performance.

Technologies and capabilities: Cloud migration, AWS, replication, security.

documents.title: Future of AI-Powered Customer Support Systems
documents.text: Cynbit discusses embedded and proactive AI support, predictive friction analysis, multimodal support, sentiment-aware interaction, human handoff and RAG-grounded support knowledge. The article emphasizes privacy-first handling for sensitive inputs.

documents.title: How AI Agents Are Transforming Business Operations in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit describes AI agents as LLM-powered systems that can reason, use tools, observe outcomes and maintain memory. Examples include sales outreach, procurement and DevOps. The article emphasizes human-in-the-loop controls, sandboxing, observability and avoiding agent loops.

documents.title: How Small Businesses Can Automate Operations Using AI
documents.text: Cynbit discusses identifying repetitive tasks, lead response, follow-ups, document extraction, invoicing, meeting intelligence, content repurposing and SEO automation. It recommends starting with a process audit and expanding in stages.

documents.title: How Companies Are Using AI for Lead Generation in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit discusses signal-based prospect research, lookalike modelling using case studies, personalized outreach, interactive lead-capture tools, first-party data and human-assisted qualification. Use privacy-conscious first-party visitor data.

documents.title: Best AI Automation Trends for Businesses in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit discusses autonomous agents, personalized customer experiences, predictive analytics, document extraction and low-code AI platforms. It warns against automating broken processes, ignoring data quality and neglecting monitoring.

documents.title: Best CRM Automation Strategies for Modern Companies in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit describes AI-assisted CRM data capture, lead scoring and routing, relationship mapping, churn prevention, personalized follow-ups and integrations. It warns about over-automation, dirty data and lack of human oversight.

documents.title: Why Every Startup Needs a Custom Dashboard in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit explains custom operational dashboards, data integration, anomaly detection, drill-down analytics and operational metrics. Technologies discussed include Next.js, D3.js, Go or Node.js, TimescaleDB and ClickHouse.

documents.title: AI vs Traditional Software Development in 2026
documents.text: Cynbit discusses AI-native software lifecycles, model-first design, AI-assisted QA and predictive maintenance, while emphasizing human engineering oversight, security and verification.

documents.title: Data Privacy as a Competitive Advantage
documents.text: Cynbit frames ethical data collection and privacy as foundations of customer trust. This content supports privacy-aware data collection and transparent handling in SmartConnect AI.
